_comment: Golden set for the enterprise retrieval path, keyed against the
corpus seeded by app/_dev_seed.py. Documents are named by their
source_ref because that is what a person writes down; doc_ids are
content-derived and change when a document is edited.
`kind` slices the report: an average can improve while one class of
query gets worse, and that is the regression that reaches users.
`forbidden` cases assert an access-control or disambiguation
boundary — retrieving one of those is a different, worse failure

cases.query: what is the Atlas budget and deadline?
cases.note: Headline case: a specific number in a specific document.

cases.query: what is the main risk to Project Atlas?
can I expense a flight booked next week?
cases.note: Paraphrase — the policy says 'fourteen days in advance'.

cases.query: do I need approval for a 90 dollar receipt?
the invoice sync is failing, what do I do?
cases.note: No shared vocabulary with the runbook title.
Exact phrase in one document only. RRF systematically under-weights single-list hits, so this is the case the lexical pin slots exist for.
A term appearing in three documents — tests multi-document recall.

cases.query: which customer has open P1 incidents?
cases.note: Requires connecting 'P1 incidents' to the customer record.

cases.query: what depends on the Vertex API and why does it matter?
cases.note: The graph edge Project Atlas -> depends_on -> Vertex API is the connection.

cases.query: how many engineers are on Atlas and are they shared?

cases.note: Restricted. A manager must not retrieve this however directly they ask.
Quoting the document's own contents must not surface it.
